prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished grounded fantasy RPG inventory icon. Generate one isolated item on a genuinely transparent alpha background, square canvas. Physically convincing high quality 3D rendered appearance with natural detailed materials, matching realistic artisan copper ring inventory art. Three-quarter view, centered complete object, occupies about 75% canvas with generous transparent margin on every side. Soft upper-left key light, clear highlights and readable silhouette at 48 pixels. No frame, text, symbols, watermark, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, hands or extra objects. Subject: Iron Bar. Dark and dense. A single heavy cast iron ingot, dark gunmetal gray broad top with a slightly rough forged texture and cool silver edges, blunt rectangular bevels.
sourceLookup: icon-audit/audit.json identifies procedural ingot geometry; icon_3d source review found only ore/deposit GLBs, not usable ingot props. No suitable authored bar model.
